description: Guards the connect-flow section that the Microsoft Teams reference page (`src/content/docs/docs/reference/integrations/microsoft-teams.mdx`) added when the setup order was corrected to install-then-link. Step 4 -- linking a Teams tenant to your Promptless organization -- is the payoff of that reordering, and it points readers at two off-page destinations to finish: the Promptless integrations page where the linking happens, and the support address for the Contact Promptless fallback. This spec fails if the Step 4 heading is renamed or removed, or if either link drifts, so a reader following the guide is not left without the step or the place to act on it.

tests.description: Confirms the Step 4 "link your Teams tenant to Promptless" section renders with its documented heading anchor and both of the outbound links it sends readers to: the Promptless integrations page and the help@gopromptless.ai support fallback.

steps.description: Open the Microsoft Teams integration reference page
Confirm the Step 4 heading renders with its documented anchor
Confirm the Promptless integrations page link points to the documented URL
Confirm the help@gopromptless.ai support mailto link is present
